[[File:SithShield.png|thumb|A Sith shield.]]
'''Sith shields''' were a type [[Shield (physical armor)/Legends|physical shields]] wielded by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warriors of old. Crafted from an [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] alloy, they were virtually impenetrable, even to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], and they absorbed the hate of combattants around them. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], such shields could still be found, although extremely rarely.<ref name="Keeping the Peace">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref>
